identify_drift_points.expected_solution:
ArgoCD's manifests/ha/base/redis-ha/chart/values.yaml overrides exactly two keys to null, and both are containerSecurityContext — not securityContext:

1. redis-ha.haproxy.containerSecurityContext: null
2. redis-ha.containerSecurityContext: null

Those are the only null-valued keys in the entire file. The upstream redis-ha chart (dandydeveloper/charts at redis-ha-4.26.6, charts/redis-ha/values.yaml — pinned by the bundled chart's requirements.yaml as redis-ha 4.26.6) defaults both to tables. Upstream also ships a pod-level securityContext beside each containerSecurityContext (haproxy.securityContext {runAsUser: 99, fsGroup: 99, runAsNonRoot: true}; top-level securityContext {runAsUser: 1000, fsGroup: 1000, runAsNonRoot: true}) — ArgoCD overrides neither, so reporting securityContext as the drift is wrong.

Helm's coalesce will not overwrite a table with a non-table, and warns: `coalesce.go:286: warning: cannot overwrite table with non table for redis-ha.redis-ha.haproxy.containerSecurityContext`. Under Helm 3.17.1 this changes what generate.sh renders into manifests/ha/base/redis-ha/chart/upstream.yaml, so the committed copy no longer matches and the codegen 'check changes to generated code' step fails.
evaluation_criteria: Must name manifests/ha/base/redis-ha/chart/values.yaml as the file holding the overrides
Must identify the key as containerSecurityContext, not securityContext
Must find BOTH occurrences and locate them by full key path: redis-ha.haproxy.containerSecurityContext and redis-ha.containerSecurityContext
Must state that each is overridden to null
Must identify charts/redis-ha/values.yaml in dandydeveloper/charts as the source of the defaults being overridden
Must give the concrete upstream default table for each drift point, not a description of it and not merely an instruction to remove the override
Must distinguish the two defaults: haproxy's table has no runAsUser; the top-level table sets runAsUser: 1000
Must trace the override chain upstream values.yaml -> ArgoCD values.yaml -> chart/upstream.yaml
May note the fix is deleting the two null lines (PR #22035), but the graded content is the upstream default value itself
